items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Oh he was Leon Jones? My daddy, yeah.

ctx.x: And what's the L for? Leon. L-E-O-N. And you're senior too? Yeah, yeah, yeah my son was just there. Ah, junior, yeah. But they know me more by John L than Leon. Yeah, except for Tulane, huh?
Yeah, they call me Leon that too. Yeah, I know. You're correct. Yeah. Why they call you Leon? Well that's my middle name? That's my middle name from my daddy.

Oh he was Leon Jones? My daddy, yeah. Yeah, let's see and uh, what's today's date? Do you remember today's date? 5th of June. June 5th, 19th. It's my birthday today. Yeah. Happy birthday 1972. You must be 21 today, huh? No, I wasn't that. Yeah. Okay. I'm not telling my age. Tell your name anyway so people know me. No, I just have to go. Yeah, my name is Dick Allen. Did you ever have any nicknames or anything they call you?
